criteria.description: Bind A, B and D to station one at 12 dots/mm and C to station two at 8 dots/mm, and select only collection modes supported at the assigned station. Equivalent tables are accepted. Binary.

Bind each job to print method, gap media and ribbon state: A uses R80 external-coated ribbon, B is direct thermal with ribbon removed, C uses R110 external-coated ribbon, ribbons cover media width, and R110-I is not substituted. Binary.

For D, distinguish 108 mm media transport/peel capacity from the 104 mm printable-image limit and 1296 requested dots versus 1248 maximum, and hold the original job rather than clipping or releasing it. Binary.

Use native 12 dots/mm for station one and 8 dots/mm for station two, reject direct reuse of the old 203 dpi station-one format on 300 dpi, and require verification of resulting physical image dimensions. Binary.

Stop host traffic and keep the job paused during setup/calibration, cool the print head before access, and if power is cycled save needed state before shutdown and restore the current job's temporary format/settings after restart. Binary.
Discard unusable leader, load the roll inward, route media under the tension section through the sensor and under the head, and set guides to touch without clamping. Binary.
For transfer work route the matching ribbon to the take-up spindle and remove slack; for B remove ribbon; then lock the head and close the media door. Binary.

Set method, gap type, width and collection mode through the supported setup path, perform automatic calibration after a relevant media size/type change, and print a test label before production. A short check must not replace required sensor recalibration. Binary.
Treat listed pressure as a starting value and determine speed/darkness from trials using the lowest settings that meet quality; do not present maxima or untested values as validated optima. Binary.

Require one consecutive five-label group before release, and after an anomaly recovery require a new first-article check before production resumes. Isolated individual labels do not replace the specified consecutive-five check. Binary.
The five-label check covers stable feed, readable text, each barcode, correct physical image size and full image, plus the applicable tear, edge or peel result. Binary.

State that machine trials and first-article results remain to be performed and do not claim that an actual trial was completed, passed, or established validated optimum settings. Score only explicit assertions about actual trial occurrence/results. A D capability or release-authority error alone is owned by d_false_release_damage and d_authorized_alternative and does not fail this item. Binary.
Provide future现场 fields or explicit instructions to record actual speed, darkness and final pressure/settings together with result, confirming person and time. Binary.
Keep setup/test samples separate from production labels and resume formal production only after completed first-article confirmation. Binary.

For skipped labels, drift or false media/ribbon indications, keep paused, verify gap-sensor position/path, use manual sensor calibration where needed, do not substitute positioning adjustment for sensor calibration, and recheck after recovery. Binary.
After sensor/feed validity is established, correct tear position in small steps with the documented direction (smaller inward, larger outward) and verify position/feed again. Binary.

For print-quality or barcode-legibility failures, first check relevant consumable, loading/path and print-head state, then adjust supported speed, darkness or pressure without defaulting to maxima, and repeat affected quality checks. Binary.
When coating is unclear, use the label-adhesive transfer check before treating material as compatible, and retain the external-coated-spindle boundary rather than substituting R110-I. Binary.

Require process authorization before changing D artwork or device. An approved alternative must preserve the required complete image and use equipment whose printing capability and actually installed collection option satisfy that approved job; after a device change recheck options, resolution and consumables. Binary.
Before release after an approved change or anomaly correction, restore configuration matching the current job and complete the applicable recalibration plus a new first-article validation. Binary.

Damage predicate. Score 0 only when the document affirmatively adopts production release for original job D by clipping/clamping the 108 mm image to the 104 mm / 1248-dot limit, treating media transport capacity as printable-image capacity, or otherwise bypassing the required process decision. Score 1 for a hold, an authorized conditional alternative, or mere omission. Repeated wording of the same adopted false release remains one event. Binary.

The substantive operating instructions are written in Chinese. Device models, units, menu labels and other necessary identifiers may remain in their native form. Judge the document as a whole and do not infer compliance from table headers or isolated keywords. Binary.
